_comment: Configuration for backend/scripts/check-participant-strings (GSP-CRV2-12 Stage 5). Scope, vocabulary and every suppression carry a stated reason; the checker refuses to run on an entry without one. Derived from the aide-checks discipline in checks/README.md, but deliberately NOT a vendored aide-checks check: checks/config/schema.json sets additionalProperties:false on its check set, and checks/.aide-checks-rev pins the package, so a repo-authored check cannot live there without forking the package.
languages_source: The two languages the platform ships. frontend/globalstrat-frontend/src/locales holds exactly en.json and zh-CN.json, and core/utils/localization.py resolves only 'zh-CN' and 'en'.

backend/core/utils/participant_messages..FIELD_LABELS: Business label for each decision field; the table that stops a storage name reaching a student.
backend/core/utils/participant_messages..ROUND_STATUS_LABELS: Round status as a participant reads it (V2-069.1).

backend/core/utils/cohort_messages.py.MESSAGES: Cohort-cap refusals shown to students and instructors.

catalogues_source: The two shared wording modules introduced by CRV2-12 (V2-061) and CRV2-10 Stage 6. A new participant-facing sentence belongs in one of them; the scope assertion below is what forces that.

scope.backend/core/views/decisions.py: The decision submit, PATCH, lock, summary and context routes. Every refusal a team can hit while playing a round arrives from here; F-PL-01 and V2-069 were both raised against this file.
scope.backend/core/serializers/decisions.py: Field- and payload-level refusals on the decision write paths, reached before the view body runs.
scope.backend/core/serializers/decision_limits: The shared non-negative rule applied to every numeric decision field.
scope.backend/core/services/price_band.py: CRV2-10 Stage 5 price-band alerts and adjustment notices, shown on the marketing and results surfaces.
scope.backend/core/engine/leaderboard.py: R35 (2026-09-17) — the inactivity-demotion notice a demoted team reads on its own results screen. The sentence is chosen and rendered here, from the stored R34 audit payload and beside the payload builder, so the wording and the recorded fact cannot drift apart. That puts a participant-facing renderer in this module, so the module belongs in this check's scope; its `context.log` lines are operator/log copy and stay technical.
scope.backend/core/services/rd_costs.py: Budget refusals rendered into the lock response and the Decision Summary.
scope.backend/core/services/funding_need.py: The V2-024 equity refusal, shown on the Decision Summary and recorded by the engine.

scope_source: The participant decision path as CRV2-12 swept it, taken from evidence/player-language/README.md's stated implementation sequence (step 1 and step 2) rather than from a tree-wide glob. Files outside this list are inventoried by generate_inventory.py and are not claimed by this check; widening the scope is a deliberate, reviewable edit here.
locales_source: The two i18next catalogues loaded by frontend/globalstrat-frontend/src/i18n.js.

frontend_sources.frontend/globalstrat-frontend/src: Every React source that can call t(). A8 and A9 read this tree and ask whether each key the interface actually calls exists in the catalogues at all — the question A6 cannot ask, because A6 compares the two catalogues against each other and a key missing from BOTH is symmetric to it.

frontend_sources_source: The single React source root loaded by frontend/globalstrat-frontend/src/i18n.js; there is no second frontend. Scanned for .js and .jsx, excluding node_modules. Keys built at run time — t(variable) or a template literal — cannot be resolved by reading the source, so the checker counts them and prints the count rather than guessing; that blind spot is stated on every run.
allow_unresolved_keys_source: Empty, and deliberately so: every unresolved key this check can see has been fixed rather than suppressed. The list began at seventeen on 2026-09-17, fell to fourteen when the three Class A strings were authored, and reached zero when the competition owner ruled that the operator tooling should be bilingual and the fourteen instructor.* keys were translated and their hard-coded English fallbacks removed. An entry here would be a key the frontend calls that no catalogue answers, suppressed by exact key with a stated reason; an entry without a reason is exit 2, and an entry that stops matching is reported as stale. Note what this list does NOT cover: a key reached through a label map or a template literal is invisible to A8, and 34 such keys are inventoried in handoff_readiness_v2/evidence/unresolved-locale-keys/keys-hidden-behind-label-maps.txt and are with the owner. An empty list here means the statically visible surface is clean, not that every key in the product resolves.
model_field_sources_source: Django model modules. The storage vocabulary is read from the model definitions themselves rather than typed out here, so a field added tomorrow is watched without anyone remembering to list it.

participant_payload_dicts.backend/core/views/decisions.py: A bare dict literal in this module is an API response payload. The R&D platform-generation prerequisite rows are built this way and RDPage.js renders each as '{requirement} — {detail}' with no t() around it, so their wording is participant copy even though it arrives as structured data. The service modules in scope are deliberately absent: a dict built in decision_limits.persisted_violations or rd_costs is an engineer's diagnostic record, and naming the model, row and field there is the point.

participant_payload_dicts_source: Read from the render path: frontend/globalstrat-frontend/src/pages/RDPage.js line 176 for the prerequisite rows, against decision_limits.py's own docstring for the diagnostic records ('an unscannable table is an unchecked table'). Judged per module rather than inferred from the path, because both shapes are the same syntax.

localised_name_arguments.market: MarketDefinition carries name_zh (models/scenario.py:133). Passing market.name raw put an English market name inside an otherwise Chinese refusal.

localised_name_arguments_source: The scenario models that declare a `name_zh` counterpart, read from backend/core/models/scenario.py. `product` and `team` are deliberately absent: TeamProduct.name and Team.name are authored by the team during play and have no translated counterpart to read, so they must stay raw. That distinction is a judgment about who authored the name, which the syntax cannot supply.
allow_literals_source: Empty, and deliberately so: after the CRV2-12 sweep no literal in the declared scope needed suppressing. Each entry would be a literal the scope assertion flags that is nevertheless not participant copy, suppressed by exact text and only inside the scope; an entry without a reason is exit 2, and an entry that no longer matches anything is reported as stale. The first draft of this file carried four speculative entries and the staleness assertion rejected every one of them.
